title: People-search opt-out links

status_key.loaded: Page loaded in our check on the verified date.
status_key.bot_check: Our automated check hit a bot or captcha wall. The address is the site's own opt-out path; open it in your own browser.
status_key.court_or_domain_notice: The domain no longer runs a people-search site. Skip it.
status_key.unreachable: Could not connect on the verified date. Retry later.

disclaimer: Not legal advice. Opt-out links change; check the date. Never pay a people-search site to remove you.

sites.name: Spokeo
sites.notes: Email verification finishes the request. Click the link promptly.

sites.name: Anywho
sites.notes: In our check this address redirected to Spokeo's opt-out page.

sites.name: BeenVerified
sites.notes: Redirects to /svc/optout/search/. Email verification finishes the request.

sites.name: PeopleConnect Suppression Center (Intelius family)
sites.notes: Free suppression portal for PeopleConnect-owned people-search sites. Do the email step in one sitting: a link in our testing expired in about 15 minutes.

sites.name: Intelius / Addresses.com
sites.notes: Addresses.com's footer link 'Exercise My Data Privacy Rights' points here. The old addresses.com/optout path returned 404.

sites.name: PeopleFinders
sites.notes: Form-based. It may ask for details such as a phone number and birth date to match your record.

sites.name: SearchPeopleFree
sites.notes: Emails a link to the form (link valid 24 hours). After you validate, the page says you have 30 minutes to remove your record. Allow 3 days.

sites.name: Whitepages
sites.notes: Five-step suppression form. Paste the URL of your listing.

sites.name: MyLife
sites.notes: Page titled 'MyLife Opt-Out Form'. The form is embedded; allow scripts if it looks blank.

sites.name: ThatsThem
sites.notes: Open in your own browser.

sites.name: Nuwber
sites.notes: Cloudflare blocks are common, sometimes in ordinary browsers too. Try another network, such as phone data.

sites.name: IDCrawl
sites.notes: Asks for the URL of the IDCrawl page that lists you, then emails a link.

sites.name: CocoFinder
sites.notes: Open in your own browser.

sites.name: PeopleSearchNow
sites.notes: Open in your own browser.

sites.name: SmartBackgroundChecks
sites.notes: Emailed form link expires in 24 hours. Allow 3 days. Privacy rights depend on your state of residence.

sites.name: USPhonebook
sites.notes: Same 24-hour link and 3-day wording. Privacy rights depend on your state of residence.

sites.name: FastPeopleSearch
sites.notes: The older /removal path redirects here. Privacy rights depend on your state of residence.

sites.name: TruePeopleSearch
sites.notes: Open in your own browser. Often grouped with the sites above; we could not read its current policy page.

sites.name: CyberBackgroundChecks
sites.notes: Open in your own browser. Often grouped with the sites above; we could not read its current policy page.

sites.name: FamilyTreeNow
sites.notes: Open in your own browser. Its opt-out runs from the record page and confirms by email.

sites.name: Radaris
sites.notes: Domain shows 'This Domain Has Been Transferred by Court Order' (Atlas Data Privacy Corporation v. Radaris.com, N.J. Super. Ct., Middlesex County, MID-L-000847-24; default judgment dated August 27, 2026, per the notice). No search and no opt-out. Reporting says the judgment is being challenged.

sites.name: Rehold
sites.notes: Same court-order transfer notice as Radaris.

sites.name: PeekYou
sites.notes: Domain shows a 'Domain Update' notice: now controlled by Atlas Data Privacy Corporation after a settlement (N.J. Super. Ct., Essex County, ESX-L-003299-25). No search and no opt-out.

sites.name: ClustrMaps
sites.notes: Connection failed on November 10, 2026. Retry later.

sites.name: California DROP (official, CA residents)
sites.notes: One verified request to registered data brokers. California residents only.
